limitations: Supporting Data Values workbook is now fully read across all12 sheets and37 exact-cell rendered pages. Rendering changes layout while preserving all cell values, labels and merge context. Reading and numerical consistency checks do not independently reproduce experiments or establish clinical truth.
C has no documented FAAP100 sequencing result. Genotypes of earlier miscarriages in either family are explicitly unknown. No molecular confirmation inferred from pedigree shading.

Mainp2 reports prenatal absent right kidney but postnatal solitary right kidney; TableS1/postnatal narrative report absent left kidney in A. Unilateral agenesis is supported, laterality conflicts are preserved.
A cerebellar hypoplasia is Absent in TableS1 but present in prenatal narrative; main head-circumference percentile below3rd differs from supplement4th. Do not silently reconcile.
Mainp2 calls clinical DEB breaks per chromosome; supplementpp13-14 calls the same2.94/0.06 numbers breaks per cell. No unit correction inferred.

Blot provenance has a cross-reference discrepancy: clinical FigureS2 legend says tubulin shared with mainFigure3A; unedited-blot page15 says Figure3C. Page15 six-lane image matches the six-lane3A/S2A layout rather than the12-lane3C layout. This observation is retained without alleging misconduct.
The graphical abstract mentions prenatal losses, but the Discussion expressly says aborted pregnancies were not genotyped and other causes cannot be excluded.
Functional evidence is a published cell-based result, not a treatment result or a recommendation for experimental execution. No wet-lab design, clinical-genomic data request or contact performed.

Workbook Figure3B N2:P2 and Q2:S2 both read FAAP100fs/fs + FAAP100(fs), although the final group has a different survival series. Published Figure3B explicitly distinguishes mutant and WT complementation and its final curve is consistent with the Q:S series. Probable duplicate-header error is an inference; original labels remain unchanged and exact raw-group identity is qualified.

Workbook Figure4D O2 reads FAAP100fs/fs + F100(WT) + MMC, duplicating M2, while adjacent N2 is F100(stg) - MMC. Published Figure4D plots a final stop-gain group with n260, matching the final column count. This supports a probable header error but does not authorize silent relabeling. Workbook also includes FANCA and frameshift groups not plotted in the final panel; all were read.

Figure3D workbook column counts253/203/321/247/289/199/266/229/267/222/219/166 and Figure3E40/40/40/40/40/40/40/41/40/40/40/40 match the published panels. Figure4D plotted subsets B,C,H,I,L,M,N,O have324/239/320/262/225/200/316/260, matching published n. Unequal blank tails remain missing entries, not measured zeros.

Workbook contains representative cell-level counts and three labeled replicate series, not identifiers for independent patients or every biological experiment. Main legends state at least three biological repeats with representative data; workbook cells do not independently substantiate all repeat distributions. FAAP100 transcript values remain reduced rather than absent, and clinical-genotype qualifications above remain.
